title: Relationship Manager
summary: Own a book of 25–30 client relationships across PMS and mutual funds. Depth over volume.
html:
You will be the first voice many of our clients hear. You listen before you pitch, you explain before you sell, and you follow up when you said you would.

What you will do

  • Run discovery conversations and build goal-based plans.
  • Coordinate onboarding with Compliance and the custodian.
  • Hold quarterly reviews and keep clients informed through market cycles.

What we look for

  • 3+ years in wealth, banking or financial distribution.
  • NISM Series V-A; Series XXI-A is a plus.
  • Fluent Bengali, Hindi and English.

title: CLCB Programme Associate
summary: Plan and run workshops, circles and community events for women at every stage of their money journey.
html:
CLCB is our purpose in action. You will design sessions, work with partner institutions and NGOs, and make sure every participant leaves with one thing she can do tomorrow.

What we look for

  • Experience in training, education or community programmes.
  • Comfort speaking to a room of first-time investors.
  • Fluent Bengali and Hindi.

title: Equity Research Intern
summary: Six months with the research desk: models, annual reports, and a lot of questions.
html:
You will support the fund manager and senior analyst with financial models, annual-report reading and sector notes under the FAITH framework.

  • Final-year or recent graduate in finance, economics or commerce.
  • Comfortable with Excel and curious about businesses.
